name: Lodoicea maldivica
note: Coco de mer: nuts washed up on the Maldives; grows wild only in the Seychelles (Crouzet 2024).

name: Pitta guajana
note: Javan banded pitta (Hydrornis guajanus): named from Buffon's 'merle de la Guiane'; type locality corrected to Java.

name: Ranodon sibiricus
note: Type locality 'near Semipalatinsk' is erroneous; lives in the Dzungarian Alatau of Kazakhstan and China (Frost 2026).

name: Dracunculus medinensis
note: Little dragon from Medina (EID 2016): the worm was once common in Arabia; it is now near eradication and GBIF has no Saudi records.

name: Elephas melitensis
note: Fossil dwarf elephant of Malta and Sicily; GBIF fossil records only from Sicily.

name: Microdyromys monspeliensis
note: Fossil dormouse; GBIF records from Germany and Bosnia only.

name: Panthera gombaszoegensis
note: Fossil cat named for its type site in Slovakia; GBIF fossil records elsewhere in Europe and Africa.

name: Bradgatia linfordensis
note: Ediacaran fossil from Charnwood Forest, Leicestershire; GBIF records only from Newfoundland.

name: Notidanus aptiensis
note: Fossil shark; GBIF records from England and Australia.

name: Suillellus caucasicus
note: Bolete described from the Caucasus; GBIF records from western Europe only (test countries widened to GE AM AZ RU).

name: Aspergillus egyptiacus
note: Soil fungus; records from Australia and Arabia, none in Egypt.

name: Cryptosporiopsis tarraconensis
note: Fungus; records from Britain and the United States.

name: Cordyceps ningxiaensis
note: Fungus described from Ningxia; GBIF records from Scandinavia, Iceland and New Guinea (probably misidentified records).

name: Phlebia wuliangshanensis
note: Fungus described from Yunnan; GBIF records only from Pakistan.

name: Catatemnus togoensis
note: Pseudoscorpion; records only from DR Congo (test countries widened to Togo and Ghana).

name: Camellia indochinensis
note: Records from China only.

name: Euonymus kachinensis
note: Records just across the border in China.

name: Melicope pahangensis
note: Records from China and Indochina.

name: Verbascum adrianopolitanum
note: Edirne (Adrianople) is on the Turkish border; records from Greece and Bulgaria.

name: Carex argunensis
note: Argun river border; records on the Russian side.

name: Raorchestes cangyuanensis
note: Border county; records just across the border in Myanmar.

name: Callionymus hainanensis
note: Marine fish; records in Vietnamese waters.

name: Leucoraja melitensis
note: Maltese skate; marine records coded to Italy, Algeria, Spain and Tunisia.

name: Bryopa melitensis
note: Marine bivalve; records from Italy, Spain and Greece.

name: Periclimenes mahei
note: Marine shrimp with its type from Mahé, Seychelles; GBIF records from Australia and Mayotte.

name: Hedysarum grandiflorum subsp. bulgaricum
note: Records from Ukraine and Russia.

name: Edraianthus serbicus
note: Records from Bulgaria (and the United States).

name: Stachys serbica
note: Records from Greece only.

name: Bachia guianensis
note: Records from Colombia and Venezuela (test countries widened to Guyana, Suriname, French Guiana).

name: Hydrornis guajanus
note: Same GBIF accepted taxon and namesake as Pitta guajana (synonym key).

name: Boletus caucasicus
note: Same GBIF accepted taxon and namesake as Suillellus caucasicus.

name: Brettanomyces bruxellensis
note: Same accepted taxon as Dekkera bruxellensis, which is recorded in Belgium.

name: Gymnancyla ruscinonella
note: Same accepted taxon as Bazaria ruscinonella, which is recorded in France.

name: Stigmatopelia senegalensis
note: Same accepted taxon as Spilopelia senegalensis, which is recorded in Senegal.

name: Curruca curruca margelanica
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Psammochloa mongolica
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Berberis sikkimensis
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Brachymystax lenok tsinlingensis
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Giraffa camelopardalis angolensis
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Aethionema arabicum
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Perenniporia japonica
note: Synonym key: only records filed under this name; absence not shown.

name: Perenniporia africana
note: Continent given a single country (Congo) in Wikidata; records in Zimbabwe and Uganda.

name: Senecio macedonicus
note: Region of Macedonia includes Greek Macedonia, where the records are.

name: Poa macedonica
note: Region of Macedonia includes Greek Macedonia, where the records are.

name: Drosophila montana
note: montana means 'of the mountains', not the state of Montana.

name: Petrorhagia alpina
note: alpina means 'alpine'; a plant of the Caucasus and Central Asia.

name: Veronica ornata
note: ornata is not a place word; a Japanese plant.

name: Aedes daliensis
note: Australian mosquito (Northern Territory, Western Australia), not from Dali in Yunnan.

name: Agave potrerana
note: Mexican agave (Chihuahua, Coahuila), linked to a peak in the United States.

name: Dipodomys merriami trinidadensis
note: Kangaroo rat of southern California and Baja California, linked to the island of Trinidad.

name: Canarium salomonense
note: Linked to Salomon Atoll (Chagos), not the Solomon Islands.

name: Astracantha arnacantha
note: Aytos belongs to the subspecies aitosensis; also a synonym key.

name: Benthodesmus vityazi
note: Named after the research ship Vityaz, not a place.
